description: This is a PHP class file defining the LDAPUserDataMapping class within the OrangeHRM LDAP DTO namespace. It models mapping attributes for LDAP user data, providing getters, setters, and utility methods for attribute handling.

classes.name: LDAPUserDataMapping
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for LDAP user attribute mappings, including attribute names for first name, middle name, last name, employee ID, work email, and user status, with methods to manipulate and retrieve these mappings.

methods.name: getFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's first name.

methods.name: getMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for the user's middle name, if set.

methods.name: setMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's middle name.

methods.name: getLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's last name.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for the employee ID, if set.

methods.name: setEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the employee ID.

methods.name: getWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for the work email, if set.

methods.name: setWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the work email.

methods.name: getUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name for user status, if set.

methods.name: setUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for user status.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the attribute mappings to an associative array.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Sets multiple attribute names at once from an array, allowing partial updates.
